body:
# Building Muslim Wise: Islamic Finance Tools for Gulf Users

One evening, I was catching up with a longtime friend who works as a financial analyst in the Gulf. As we talked about investments, he casually mentioned that there are limited resources for finding halal stocks tailored specifically for the Muslim community. It hit me then: if a finance expert was struggling to find reliable tools, how were average users coping? 

This conversation sparked the creation of Muslim Wise, an Islamic finance app focused on providing essential tools for Gulf users looking to navigate the world of halal investing. We wanted to equip users with everything from a halal stock screener to a zakat calculator. Why does it matter? Because Islamic finance isn’t just a trend; it’s a fundamental lifestyle choice for millions around the world.

## The Build / Story

Building this app wasn’t a walk in the park. Initially, we envisioned a simple platform with a few features, but the feedback we received during early development forced us to rethink our approach. We engaged with potential users, and it became clear that we needed more than just a stock screener. There was a desire for an integrated solution tailored to Islamic finance needs in the Gulf region.

One of the major challenges we faced was sourcing accurate data for halal stock screening. There are numerous criteria and nuances in determining whether a stock complies with Islamic laws, and gathering reliable data was no small feat. On top of that, we had to consider the complexities of different Islamic opinions on finance. Honestly? It was overwhelming. But the potential impact on our users kept us fueled. Each setback was a reminder of why we were doing this: to create a trustworthy tool for those navigating Islamic finance.

## Key Features

### Halal Stock Screener
Muslim Wise includes a comprehensive halal stock screener, making it easy for users to filter and find investments that align with Islamic principles. This feature allows you to view stocks across multiple sectors, ensuring compliance with Shariah law.

### Zakat Calculator
Our zakat calculator simplifies charity obligations, helping users calculate their zakat with ease. Input your assets and let the app do the heavy lifting, so you can focus on what truly matters: giving back.

### User-Friendly Interface
We designed Muslim Wise with the user in mind. Navigating through various financial tools should not be a chore. An intuitive layout makes finding precise information straightforward and efficient, whether you're a seasoned investor or a newcomer.

### Educational Content
Understanding Islamic finance can be daunting. That’s why we included a section dedicated to educational resources. Here, users can read articles, watch videos, and gain insights into ethical investing that align with their faith.

## Real Numbers / Proof
Since we launched, we've reached about 2,500 downloads across five countries, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia. User feedback has been overwhelmingly positive—people appreciate the fact that they can find halal investments without sifting through countless irrelevant options. Sure, those numbers are small in the grand scheme of the app world, but they feel huge to us. Each download represents someone who sees the value in what we built.

You can check it out and join our growing community on the Play Store: [Muslim Wise](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ofbuilder.muslimwise) or head over to [ofbuilder.com](https://ofbuilder.com) for more insights and updates.

## Closing
What’s next for Muslim Wise? We’re constantly evolving based on user feedback. In the coming months, we’ll be adding more educational features and deepening our stock analysis. This isn’t just about an app; it’s about fostering a community around informed, ethical investing. I genuinely believe we’re on the verge of something meaningful here.

I look forward to seeing how Muslim Wise can grow and continuously meet the needs of our users. Because, at the end of the day, it's not just about finance; it's about faith and trust in every investment we make.
